Facts used:
- Lindenmoor’s 2025 population was 29,051 residents. [NR-08]
- Lindenmoor households used 2,151,400 cubic metres of water in 2025. [NR-08]
- Kelmarsh’s 2025 population was 24,117 residents. [NR-04]
- Kelmarsh households used 1,739 megalitres of water in 2025. [NR-04]
- One megalitre is 1,000 cubic metres. [NR-15]
- 2025 was not a leap year, so it had 365 days.

Calculations:
- Lindenmoor water: 2,151,400 cubic metres × 1,000 litres per cubic metre = 2,151,400,000 litres.
- Lindenmoor daily per-resident use: 2,151,400,000 ÷ 29,051 ÷ 365 = 202.927 litres.
- Kelmarsh water: 1,739 megalitres × 1,000 cubic metres per megalitre × 1,000 litres per cubic metre = 1,739,000,000 litres.
- Kelmarsh daily per-resident use: 1,739,000,000 ÷ 24,117 ÷ 365 = 197.604 litres.
- Difference: 202.927 − 197.604 = 5.323 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.323
